actors.blurb: Trump is dominating the news cycle with a flurry of actions: emergency relief requests, a ban on Canadian imports, emergency AI summit meetings, rollout of lower vehicle fuel‑economy standards, and high‑profile campaign rallies and appearances at sports events. These moves are sparking intense debate across trade, climate, technology and election politics.
